skills.install_confirm:
Install {name} from {source} for this Windows/macOS user?

AuraChat will run npx skills add globally for Codex. Requires Node.js and Git; downloads third-party software and also makes the skill available to compatible editors. Only install from trusted sources.
skills.install_note: New skills are enabled by default. Global installation via npx skills requires Node.js 22.20+ and Git. CLI telemetry is disabled. Skills provide instructions, not additional permissions.

voice.privacy: Audio stays in memory on this computer and is never sent to external services. Only text enters the chat. Language: English. Maximum recording: 2 minutes. The model loads into memory when the app starts and the microphone activates only when it is ready; speed depends on your computer.
